broadcast.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for sending a data packet over the ESP-NOW protocol to every device on the same Wi-Fi channel that is listening for ESP-NOW broadcasts. It is equivalent to using `espnow.send` with the address `FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF`. See [Broadcasting](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#broadcasting) below for a discussion of when broadcasts are appropriate.

peer.add.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) to add a new peer to the internal allowed peers list.

peer.delete.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) to remove a known peer from the internal allowed peers list.

send.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for sending a data packet over the ESP-NOW protocol to a specific peer.

set_channel.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) to change the Wi-Fi channel that ESP-NOW is sending and receiving on. It has no effect when the [Wi-Fi](https://esphome.io/components/wifi/) component is enabled, since the channel is then determined by the associated Wi-Fi network.

auto_add_peer.docs:
**boolean**: When set to `true`, the ESP-NOW component will automatically add any new incoming device as a peer. See [Peers](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#peers) below. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

enable_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the ESP-NOW component on boot. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

max_payload_size.docs:
**int**: The largest payload, in bytes, this device can send and receive in one frame. Values above `250` use ESP-NOW v2 frames (up to `1470` bytes), only work with peers that also support them, and reserve proportionally more RAM for packet buffers. This only sizes this device's buffers; the protocol version itself is negotiated with each peer automatically. Defaults to `250`.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

on_broadcast.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a broadcast packet is received. May be specified multiple times. See [`on_broadcast`](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#espnow-on_broadcast).

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**MAC Address**: Only fire this trigger when the packet's source address matches. If not set, the trigger fires for any source address.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

on_receive.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a directed (non-broadcast) packet is received from a registered peer. May be specified multiple times. See [`on_receive`](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#espnow-on_receive).

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

on_unknown_peer.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a packet is received from a device that is not registered as a peer. See [`on_unknown_peer`](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#espnow-on_unknown_peer).

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

peers.docs:
**list of MAC Address**: The list of MAC addresses of the devices that this device is allowed to communicate with. See [Peers](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#peers) below.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

continue_on_error.docs:
**boolean**: If set to `false`, the surrounding automation will be aborted if the send fails. Cannot be `false` when `wait_for_sent` is `false`. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

data.docs:
**string or list of bytes**: The data to be sent. The maximum payload size is the configured `max_payload_size` (250 bytes by default).

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

on_error.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the data could not be sent.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

on_sent.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the data is sent successfully (the receiver has acknowledged the packet).

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*

wait_for_sent.docs:
**boolean**: If `true`, the automation will wait for the underlying send operation to complete (and for any `on_sent` or `on_error` actions to finish) before continuing with the next action. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [ESPNow communication Component](https://esphome.io/components/espnow#configuration-variables)*
